description.value:
Duration constant

You can't be counteracted, dispelled, or have your ongoing effects suppressed by a creature of a lower level than you. Once per day, when a creature of any level fails to counteract or dispel one of your effects, that specific creature can never attempt to counteract that effect again.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Cannot be counteracted/dispelled/suppressed by a lower-level creature; once per day, a creature that fails to counteract your effect can never try again" needs a counteract/dispel-resistance selector. Confirmed this session: no Suppress-style rule element and no counteract-named rule element exists anywhere in pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/ (directory listing checked directly). Real pf2e's counteract mechanic compares a counteracting effect's modifier to the target effect's DC rather than having the target roll a save, so this card's entire premise doesn't map onto any roll the character makes.
